Who We Are

Built on Precision

APIC Technosol Engineering is a specialized engineering company delivering high-quality Pneumatic components, Hydraulic systems, and Precision Machined parts to industries across India.

From sourcing world-class pneumatic cylinders and solenoid valves to building complete automation panels and SPMs, we are a one-stop engineering partner for manufacturing businesses.

Official Partnership

Authorised Master Distributor of C.Matic

APIC Technosol Engineering is an authorised Master Distributor of C.Matic S.p.A., Italy — a world leader in pneumatic fittings and connectors since 1979. We supply the complete Cmatic product range across India with full technical support.
